segments.template: {{ $bgA := "#333333" }}{{ $bgB := "#1a1a1a" }}{{ $arrow := "\ue0b0" }}{{ $icon := "\uf07b" }}{{ $parts := splitList "\\" .Path }}{{ $count := len $parts }}{{ range $i, $p := $parts }}{{ $bg := $bgA }}{{ if eq (mod $i 2) 1 }}{{ $bg = $bgB }}{{ end }}<#e6e6e6,{{ $bg }}> {{ if eq $i 0 }}{{ $icon }} {{ end }}{{ $p }} </>{{ if lt (add $i 1) $count }}{{ $nextBg := $bgA }}{{ if eq (mod (add $i 1) 2) 1 }}{{ $nextBg = $bgB }}{{ end }}<{{ $bg }},{{ $nextBg }}>{{ $arrow }}</>{{ else }}<{{ $bg }},transparent>{{ $arrow }}</>{{ end }}{{ end }}
